summary: The first screen/RNG mismatch occurs on the monster turn after a cursed invisibility potion. potion.c peffect_invisibility() calls the void wizard.c aggravate(); JavaScript currently records note_unported() there, leaving the sleeping orc asleep. Port the whole aggravate() function and wire its existing JavaScript gap callers. The queue’s distfleeck RNG tag is downstream of the missing state change.

source.branch: For each living monster in the current fmon chain whose In_W_tower() result matches the hero’s, aggravate() clears STRAT_WAITFORU and STRAT_APPEARMSG and sets msleeping to zero. If that monster cannot move, it then rolls rn2(5); only a zero result clears mfrozen and restores mcanmove. The function returns void and emits no message.

JavaScript routes q through js/cmd.js dodrink dispatch into js/potion.js dodrink()/dopotion()/peffects()/peffect_invisibility(); peffect_invisibility() currently leaves note_unported('wizard.c aggravate') at js/potion.js:1385.

dependencies: dungeon.c In_W_tower() returns the consumed hero/monster region predicate. js/dungeon.js already exports In_W_tower(x, y, level, state); compute the hero result once and compare it with each monster result in source order.

The C global fmon linked list maps to state.level.monlist. DEADMONSTER(mtmp) is the mhp < 1 check. Update each existing monster object in place: clear exactly STRAT_WAITFORU | STRAT_APPEARMSG, clear msleeping, and conditionally set mfrozen=0 and mcanmove=1.

rng.c rn2() supplies the consumed result only when mcanmove is false. js/wizard.js already imports rn2; use the call-site random stream where its caller supplies one. Calls to aggravate() discard its void result, so there is no return-valued dependency.
